module: Per-frame camera update loop, separate from core/camera.lua. It processes the player's main view then the extra render contexts (split screen, video streams): fills camData (position, velocity, dt, tracked vehicle), calls the selected camera mode (global camera or vehicle camera), then the "running" cameras (filters), and copies the result into finalCameraData. core_camera injects its state via setup() and exposes onPreRender / onClientPostStartMission as its own callbacks; a modder does not normally call anything here.
notes: Emitted hooks: onCameraChanged(player, camName, vehId) when the camera name or vehicle changes for a context (player is 0 if the context has no player); onCameraPreRender(camData) only on the main view and only when a global camera's update() succeeded.
If the camera computations give NaN/inf, the last valid pose is reused and the mode is reset via cam:init() (error log).
Cascading fallback: missing vehicle camera -> "orbit" -> free camera (commands.setFreeCamera() on the main view; on an extra context, the context's 'free' global camera).
camData.dt is multiplied by cameraM.speedFactor (dtSim, dtReal, dtRaw too). On the main view, the sun shadow distance is 0.5 when driving (attached camera) and 1.0 with a global camera.
The SSAO radius goes to 0.5 when the camera is inside the vehicle (and 1.5 outside), except in bigMap mode.
The default nearClip comes from theLevelInfo.nearClip, otherwise 0.1; the default fov is 60.

setup.desc: Receives from core/camera.lua its state tables and utility functions (extraContexts, mainContext, moveManager, getGlobalCameras, getVehicleData, getRunningCamsOrder, setGlobalCameraByName, set, vehicleChanged, isInsideBasedOnCameras, isUnicycle, cameraM). Called once by core_camera.

deps.desc: Table of dependencies injected by core_camera, keys listed above.

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook called after a level starts: forgets the level's nearClip and the camera's inside/outside state so that the SSAO radius is reapplied.

onPreRender.desc: Called every frame before rendering (via core_camera): updates the main view then each extra context. Does nothing while levelLoaded is false.

dtSim.desc: smoothed simulation dt (accounts for slow motion/pause), in seconds

dtRaw.desc: raw render dt, real clock, in seconds
